# Parity fixtures

Store minimized, provenance-recorded reference inputs and expected outputs here. Every fixture identifies the pinned source revision, evidence path or runtime probe, and extraction method. The [Remix reference corpus](remix-reference-corpus.json) captures normalized object records and their source catalog, default game state, initial rates, nine controlled damage/earnings scenarios, level 0→1 upgrade outputs, notation samples, Decimal behavior, and seeded RNG behavior. Decimal, RNG, notation, object-generation, and formula-only damage/rate slices are compared by Beyond tests; the complete game simulation remains unimplemented and is not parity-certified. The fixture records the MIT notice; see the preserved [upstream license](../../../docs/knowledge/sources/licenses/idle-mine-remix-MIT.txt).
